title: Operator Sim 1: Budget Allocation
brief: An online footwear brand in Agra wants to scale their sales campaign with a budget of ₹1,200/day for 7 days. Configure targeting, placements, and creative to achieve at least 25 online sales with an average ROAS of at least 2.5x!
